name: primitive
description: Email infrastructure for AI agents. Send, receive, search, and reply to email from inside Codex over the hosted Primitive MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Email infrastructure for AI agents in Codex
interface.longDescription: Primitive bundles its hosted MCP server plus the primitive-chat and primitive-inbox skills so Codex can send email and await the threaded reply, and receive and read mail at a managed *.primitive.email address with no SMTP, DNS, or mail server. The same server backs Primitive's ChatGPT app and Claude connector.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send an email and wait for the reply with Primitive.
capabilities: Send email and await the threaded reply
Receive and read inbound email at a managed address
Search inbound email and pull full conversation threads
